content: Do not insult the crocodile while your feet are still wading in the river.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Arrogant, reckless boasting before you have crossed the perilous territory is suicidal vanity. When navigating dangerous political environments, corporate negotiations, or delicate relationships, keep your counsel, cross to dry land, and speak only when safe.
practicalInsight: Exercise tactical silence in a sensitive situation today. Secure your footing before voicing bold declarations.
reflectionPrompt: Are you prematurely provoking conflict before you have secured safety for yourself and your team?
